text:
Gold Price in 2015
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2015, the LBMA gold price fell 15.9% between 2015-01-30 ($1,260) and 2015-12-30 ($1,060). The highest sampled price was $1,260 in January and the lowest was $1,060 in December. The mean of these observations was $1,151. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2015:
A strong US dollar and expectations of Federal Reserve rate hikes pushed gold to multi-year lows.
